notes: TBox revision on has_minimum_age: every United States Senator must be at least 40 years old instead of 30. No more general rule gives 30: the House (25) and the presidency (35) have their own minimums. The age is a qualification at the time of taking the seat (Henry Clay and John Eaton were seated under 30 in error, which does not change the rule). 40 is a round age, plausible and clearly false. Near query asks the House's minimum age (25). Derived queries name fictional senators in the prompt (inheritance, 2 hops); the third is an application (the number on a certificate). Propositional: the conjunction's side fact (Newton) is true, the disjunction's (Norway in South America) false, each with a check. Determinate only, no worlds. Caveat: the derived queries ask for the member's minimum age, which restates the rule with a name attached.
